technology_type.evidence: inferred: Mass spectrometry analysis was conducted on a Thermo Fisher QE-HFX coupled to a Vanquish Neo UHPLC. Approximately 1 µg of each sample was loaded onto an EASY-Spray PepMap RSLC C18 column (2 µm, 100A, 75µm x 50 cm) and eluted at 300 nl/min over a 120-minute gradient. MS1 spectra were collected at 120,000 resolution with a full scan range of 350 – 1400 m/z, a maximum injection time of 50ms and the automatic gain control (AGC) set to 3e6.
